import numpy as np

# 2. Check for missing values in duration_in_seconds

).iloc[0,0]

import sqlite3
import pandas as pd

    GROUP BY duration_in_seconds
    ORDER BY duration_in_seconds DESC
    LIMIT 15;
""", conn)

# Verify no ties in top 15

    GROUP BY duration_in_seconds
    HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
    ORDER BY duration_in_seconds DESC

""", conn)

if tie_check.empty:
    print("No ties found in top 15 durations")
else:
    print("The following durations have ties:")
    print(tie_check)

conn.close()
